entities.name: Porringer Basin
entities.description: Flooded valley on Lorwyn, once a wooded vale known as Porringer Valley, resettled by merrow.

entities.name: Ash Treefolk
entities.description: Treefolk whose ancestral home was Porringer.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblin-like folk who sheltered in the valley and held the Feast of Footbottom.

entities.name: Feast of Footbottom
entities.description: Peaceful boggart gathering held in the valley.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: Elf tribe whose forces under Nath fought in Porringer.

entities.name: Nath
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf elf who commanded forces hoping to set up an outpost in the valley.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Elf whose powerful spell destroyed both forces; banished from the valley by a greater elemental.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Impending event that made the boggarts feral.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: Community that flooded and resettled the valley as a nursery.

entities.name: White Winged Elk
entities.description: Greater elemental that banished Rhys and prophesied the Great Aurora.

events.summary: Gilt-Leaf elves under Nath attacked boggarts at the Footbottom festival; the boggarts turned feral under the coming Great Aurora.
events.quote: the boggarts began to change under the influence of the impending Great Aurora

events.summary: Rhys cast a powerful spell that destroyed both forces and the valley's life.
events.quote: a powerful spell cast by the elf Rhys

events.summary: A greater elemental banished Rhys and prophesied the Great Aurora.
events.quote: The elemental banished Rhys from the valley

events.summary: The valley was flooded and resettled by merrow.
events.quote: The valley was later flooded and resettled by merrow
